description: ItemBatch and Stock archival tables — reduces live table bloat from expired zero-stock batches
issue: #20724 — archive expired zero-stock ItemBatch records to reduce table bloat
author: Dr M H B Ariyaratne
tables_created: ITEMBATCHARCHIVE — same schema as ITEMBATCH + ARCHIVEDAT timestamp; keeps original IDs
STOCKARCHIVE — same schema as STOCK + ARCHIVEDAT timestamp; keeps original IDs
columns_added: PHARMACEUTICALBILLITEM.ARCHIVEDITEMBATCH_ID BIGINT NULL — FK to ITEMBATCHARCHIVE; set by archival job before live ITEMBATCH_ID is nullified so bill viewing falls back to archive
note: This migration only creates the schema. The archival job (ItemBatchArchivalService) performs the actual data movement. Run a dry-run preview from the admin page before the first live run.
